info.title: Hakathon Backend API
info.description: FastAPI backend with Keycloak OAuth2, PostgreSQL, and Milvus

post.description:
Authenticate user with email and password (direct authentication).

Args:
    login_request: Login credentials (email and password)

Returns:
    Access token and user information

Raises:
    HTTPException: If authentication fails

get.description:
Get Keycloak login URL for OAuth2 authentication.

Args:
    redirect_uri: URL to redirect to after authentication

Returns:
    Login URL and state parameter

post.description:
Register a new user with direct authentication.

Args:
    registration_request: User registration data

Returns:
    Access token and user information

Raises:
    HTTPException: If registration fails

Handle OAuth2 callback and exchange code for tokens.

Args:
    code: Authorization code from Keycloak
    state: State parameter for security verification
    redirect_uri: Original redirect URI used in authorization request

Returns:
    Access token and user information

get.description:
Get current authenticated user information.

Args:
    current_user: Current authenticated user

Returns:
    Current user information

post.description:
Logout current user (invalidate token on client side).

Args:
    current_user: Current authenticated user

Returns:
    Logout confirmation

schema.title: Response Logout Api V1 Auth Logout Post

get.description:
Test connection to Keycloak authentication server.

Returns:
    Connection status and server information

schema.title: Response Test Auth Connection Api V1 Auth Test Connection Get

get.description:
Protected endpoint that requires authentication.

Args:
    current_user: Current authenticated user

Returns:
    Protected resource data

schema.title: Response Protected Endpoint Api V1 Auth Protected Get

get.description:
Comprehensive system health check.

Args:
    db: Database session

Returns:
    System health status including all services

Test database connectivity and basic operations.

Args:
    db: Database session

Returns:
    Database connection test results

schema.title: Response Test Database Connection Api V1 Test Database Get

post.description:
Create a test user to verify database operations.

Args:
    user_data: User creation data
    db: Database session
    current_user: Current authenticated user

Returns:
    Created user information

get.description:
List all users in the database.

Args:
    db: Database session
    current_user: Current authenticated user

Returns:
    List of all users

schema.title: Response List Test Users Api V1 Test Users Get

delete.description:
Delete a test user by ID.

Args:
    user_id: User ID to delete
    db: Database session
    current_user: Current authenticated user

Returns:
    Deletion confirmation

schema.title: Response Delete Test User Api V1 Test Users  User Id  Delete

get.description:
Test authentication flow and token validation.

Args:
    current_user: Current authenticated user

Returns:
    Authentication test results

schema.title: Response Test Authentication Flow Api V1 Test Auth Test Get

get.description: Returns the profile information for the currently authenticated user.
Get a specific user's profile. Users can only access their own profile unless they are admin.

put.description: Update a user's profile. Users can only update their own profile unless they are admin.

delete.description: Delete a user account. Admin access required.

get.description: Get a paginated list of users with optional search functionality. Admin access required.

post.description: Create a new user account. Admin access required.

get.description: Get statistics for a specific user. Users can only access their own stats unless they are admin.
Get a list of items. Returns public items for anonymous users.

post.description: Create a new item. Ownership is automatically assigned to the authenticated user.

get.description: Get a specific item. Private items can only be accessed by their owner.

put.description: Update an item. Only the owner can update their items.

delete.description: Delete an item. Only the owner can delete their items.

get.description: Get all items owned by the current authenticated user.

post.description:
Upload a document for sensitive data scanning.

Accepts PDF and DOCX files up to 50MB in size.
The document will be queued for automatic scanning after upload.

get.description:
List user's documents with filtering and pagination.

Returns a paginated list of documents owned by the current user.

Get detailed information about a specific document.

Returns document metadata, scanning status, and optionally
sensitive data detections found during scanning.

delete.description:
Delete a document.

Performs a soft delete of the document and its associated data.

post.description:
Trigger sensitive data scanning for a document.

Starts the scanning process to detect sensitive information
in the document content.

get.description:
Get document content if safe to view.

Returns the extracted text content only if the document
has been scanned and contains no sensitive data.

Get document scanning statistics for the current user.

Returns aggregated statistics about the user's documents
and their scanning status.

Get sensitive data detections for a document.

Returns all sensitive data detections found in the specified document.

schema.title: Response Get Document Detections Api V1 Documents  Document Id  Detections Get

put.description:
Review a sensitive data detection.

Mark a detection as reviewed and optionally as a false positive.
Only the document owner can review detections.

get.description:
Health check endpoint.

Returns:
    Health status information

Root endpoint.

Returns:
    API information
